task: Fix refund processing in refunds.py and amounts.py. refund(orders,ledger,order_id,request_id,amount) uses integer cents; amount must be positive int, never bool/float. orders maps IDs to {paid:int,refunded:int,status:str}; ledger maps request IDs to {order_id,amount,refunded_total}. New refunds only allowed for paid/partially_refunded states, cannot exceed paid minus refunded, and unknown order raises ValueError. Successful refunds update refunded and status (refunded when full, partially_refunded otherwise), save a ledger entry and return a separate copy. Repeating the same request ID with identical order/amount returns a copy of its original entry without any mutation, even after later refunds or terminal state. Reusing request ID with different order or amount raises ValueError. Validate invalid amount even on retries. Every rejection must leave both mappings unchanged. Returned entries must not alias ledger entries. Preserve APIs. Public reproduction: two distinct partial refunds do not accumulate.
